note: ng v0, zero-shot. score = -dist - 100*(no_cycle + j_unreachable + over_capacity), threshold -50. Each impossibility is an exact step built from two ReLUs: step(z) = relu(M z) - relu(M z - 1) with M = 1e5 (one time unit over H < 12000 already saturates). Effect: neighbours that can never be revisited after j are dropped and the slot goes to the next-nearest neighbour that can. Features: [dist, dist_rank, cycle_slack, reach_j, cap_slack, tw_width_k, tw_width_j].
